title: DEF CON 26  - Christopher Domas - GOD MODE UNLOCKED Hardware Backdoors in redacted x86
summary: Christopher Domas presents research at DEF CON 26 showing a hidden alternate instruction set and undocumented hardware backdoor in some x86 processors, found on a third-party CPU. He uses it to ask how feasible wider hardware backdoors are.
why: HN regulars treat Domas as a favorite hacker and bring this talk up in any discussion of CPU backdoors, hidden instruction sets or processor security.

quote.text: Christopher Domas is one of my absolute favorite all-time hackers. He does such a fantastic job of explaining his work.
